cards.text: Jesus is talking with the Pharisees, the strictest group in the Jewish religion (Acts 26:5). They ask Him a big one: when is the kingdom of God going to come? They want a date, friend, and a tracking number.

cards.question: Jesus tells the Pharisees the kingdom of God will not come with observable signs.

cards.text: No signs to watch for. And nobody's going to say, 'Look, here it is,' like it's a set of car keys somebody finally found in the couch.

cards.question: So where does Jesus tell the Pharisees the kingdom of God is?

cards.text: Then Jesus turns to His disciples. He calls Himself the Son of Man (Luke 22:48), and He tells them a time is coming when they'll long to see one of the days of the Son of Man.

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples that when they long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, they will see it.

cards.text: And people will tell them, 'Look, there He is!' or 'Look, here He is!' Friend, that's every group chat when somebody THINKS they saw a celebrity at the gas station.

cards.question: When people tell them "Look, there He is!" what does Jesus tell the disciples to do?

answers.text: Send one of them to look

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples not to chase those reports. What does He say the Son of Man will be like in His day?

answers.text: Like a quiet knock at night

cards.text: Lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other. Nobody needs a group chat to tell them about THAT.

cards.question: But first, Jesus says, the Son of Man must suffer many things and be ___ by this generation.

cards.text: Then Jesus reaches WAY back, further back than the oldest takeout menu in my old junk drawer, to Noah, the man God told to build the ark (Genesis 6:14). He says just as it was in the days of Noah, so it will be in the days of the Son of Man.

cards.question: In Noah's day, right up until Noah entered the ark, what were people doing?

cards.text: Then the flood came and destroyed them all. And Jesus says it was the SAME in the days of Lot, Abraham's nephew (Genesis 12:5).

cards.question: Jesus says people in Lot's day were busy buying and selling, planting and building.
Then Lot leaves the city of Sodom. What rains down from heaven that very day?

cards.text: Fire and sulfur destroyed them all. Two stories, same rhythm: regular day, regular day, regular day, and then it's over, and Jesus says it will be just like that on the day the Son of Man is revealed.

cards.question: On that day, Jesus says someone up on the housetop should come down and grab his possessions first.

cards.text: Same for someone out in the field. Don't go back for anything left behind.

cards.question: Right after that, Jesus tells the disciples to remember someone's wife. Whose?

cards.text: As Lot's family fled Sodom, Lot's wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt (Genesis 19:26).

cards.question: Jesus says whoever tries to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will ___ it.
Jesus says two people will be in one bed on that night: one will be ___ and the other left.

cards.text: Same with two women grinding grain together. One taken, the other left.
Then the disciples ask, 'Where, Lord?' Jesus answers, 'Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.'
